keyEvents.text: Goal! Columbus Crew 1, New England Revolution 0. Brais Méndez (Columbus Crew) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Mohamed Farsi.
Tarun Karumanchi (Columbus Crew) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Columbus Crew 1, New England Revolution 1. Matt Polster (New England Revolution) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mamadou Fofana with a headed pass following a corner.
Goal! Columbus Crew 1, New England Revolution 2. Dor Turgeman (New England Revolution) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Carles Gil.
First Half ends, Columbus Crew 1, New England Revolution 2.
Second Half begins Columbus Crew 1, New England Revolution 2.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Cesar Ruvalcaba replaces Tarun Karumanchi.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Gonzalo Tapia replaces Josef Martínez.
Alhassan Yusuf (New England Revolution) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Columbus Crew 1, New England Revolution 3. Carles Gil (New England Revolution) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Peyton Miller.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Wilson Harris replaces Dor Turgeman.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Ilay Feingold replaces Jack Harrison.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Dylan Chambost replaces André Gomes.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Lautaro Giaccone replaces Brais Méndez.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Andrés Herrera replaces Eric Bailly.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Diego Fagúndez replaces Carles Gil.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Jackson Yueill replaces Alhassan Yusuf.
Second Half ends, Columbus Crew 1, New England Revolution 3.
